rows.what_happened: FY2014 Capital Plan voted (Art. 14, $652,483). The held report prints the vote but no item list; no field line can be shown or excluded from it.
rows.quote: to fund the FY 14 Capital Plan, as recommended by the Capital Planning Committee
rows.note: Absence of an item list is a property of the printed report, not evidence the field was absent. The meeting date is blank in town-meeting-votes.csv and was not read from the page; the 2013 Annual Town Meeting date is therefore unverified here.
rows.plain: FY2014 capital plan voted; our copy prints the total but no item list.

rows.what_happened: A selectman asked how the turf and track replacement would be funded; the Town Manager said it is her intention to put the replacement into the Capital Plan. No request amount is stated.
rows.requester: Town Manager (intention); question raised by a selectman
rows.quote: It is Ms. Speidel's intention to put the replacement into the Capital Plan and she believes the life of the turf was to expire around the year 2017.
rows.note: Intention only. The FY2014 plan list is not printed in the held annual report (ATM 4 May 2013 Art. 14, $652,483, FY2013 report pdf p86 prints only the vote), so whether the field was on the FY2014 list cannot be read from it. CPC minutes 2013 (48 documents) were searched for "turf": no hit before 2015-10-27 -- a statement about the search.
rows.plain: Asked how the turf and track replacement would be paid for, the Town Manager says she means to put it in the capital plan.

rows.plain: FY2015 capital plan: no field line.

rows.what_happened: Finance Committee opened discussion of future maintenance and renovation costs of the Turf Field and Track; reviewed a spreadsheet of construction funding and user fees.
rows.quote: Turf Field and Track: Initial discussion on future costs for maintenance and renovation.
rows.plain: The Finance Committee starts discussing what the turf field and track will cost to keep up and replace.

rows.what_happened: Select Board to meet with all involved with the turf field on ownership, fees and how the turf will be replaced three years out. No amount.
rows.quote: to discuss how the turf will be replaced 3 years from now
rows.note: Context for the FY2015-FY2017 cycles; nothing was requested in a capital plan.
rows.plain: The Select Board plans a meeting on who owns the turf field, the fees, and replacing it in three years.

rows.what_happened: Parks Commission and Finance Committee: turf field and track likely to need major reconstruction at an estimated $600,000-$800,000 in the next few years; Town Manager said funds would have to accrue at about $100,000 a year.
rows.quote: the turf field and track will need major reconstruction in an estimated cost range of $600,000-$800,000 in the next few years
rows.note: Estimate, not a request or appropriation. Earlier, SB 2011-03-22 minutes record the Park Commission citing a $600,000 estimate from Field Turf for 2017/18 (meetings/text/select-board/2011-03-22-minutes-4780.txt).
rows.plain: Parks Commission and Finance Committee: the field and track will need rebuilding in a few years, an estimated $600,000-$800,000.

rows.body: Department of Public Works annual report (FY2015)
rows.what_happened: DPW Director reports the multi-use track complex "is in dire need of repair"; funding and organised effort between Commissioners and users "sadly lacking". No request amount.
rows.quote: The multi-use track complex is in dire need of repair.
rows.note: Report text, not a request form. The FY2016 capital plan printed in the same report (pdf p93, 13 rows, $1,051,578) has no field line.
rows.plain: The DPW director's annual report says the track complex “is in dire need of repair”.

rows.what_happened: Capital Planning Committee minutes list "Projects": Turf Field $800,000 (with Five Intersections, Townsend Harbor Bridge, Stormwater Update, Pavement Management Plan). Background: the town has not accrued funds; minute says "So this is an FY18 project at the earliest" in the same block.
rows.requester: not stated in the minute (the list sits under a Town Manager/DPW discussion; unnamed)
rows.quote: Projects Turf Field: $800,000.
rows.note: Which fiscal year the $800,000 was for: the minute says FY18 at the earliest, but the sentence sits in a block that may refer to a different item (the block mixes projects). Hypothesis only: that it is the turf. The quote is verbatim; the line break is in the source.
rows.plain: The capital committee lists the turf field at $800,000 among coming projects; the town has set nothing aside for it.

rows.what_happened: Bond counsel: turf/track/field does not qualify for contingency fund spending. Track surface about one year from needing $150,000 repair; later cost "a multiple". Turf may last another year. Committee asked whether such large projects belong in the capital process.
rows.requester: Town Manager / staff (source of estimate not named)
rows.quote: The estimate is that the Town has about one year to repair the track surface at a cost of $150,000.
rows.note: Estimate only. Same minute: "Whether the Capital Planning Process should include large projects (e.g. building re-use projects, renovation of the turf track and field".
rows.plain: Bond counsel says the field can’t use the contingency fund; the track surface is about a year from a $150,000 repair.

rows.what_happened: Town Manager: working with the Parks Commission on a financing plan for replacing the existing turf field and track using non-budgetary funds.
rows.quote: She has been working with the Parks Commission on a financing plan for the replacement of the existing turf field and track.
rows.plain: The Town Manager is working with the Parks Commission on a way to pay for it outside the budget.

rows.what_happened: Warrant preview: borrowing to replace the turf field; funding source "would be the cell tower revenue and rental fees". Number printed there is Article 33; it became Article 28 at Town Meeting.
rows.requester: Select Board warrant (submitted by Board of Selectmen per the printed article)
rows.quote: Article 33 is to authorize borrowing for the replacement of the existing turf field.
rows.note: Article numbering moved between the warrant draft (33) and the meeting (28).
rows.plain: Warrant preview: borrow to replace the turf, repaid from cell tower revenue and rental fees.

rows.what_happened: Finance Committee took no position before Town Meeting on funding for renovation of the turf field and track; awaited the presentation.
rows.quote: Funding for renovation of the turf field and track. The committee wants to find out more about the financing option before making a recommendation.
rows.plain: The Finance Committee waits for the presentation before taking a position.

rows.what_happened: Select Board recommended Articles 27 (cell tower lease) and 28 (turf and track), 4-1. School/athletic contributions described: $25,000 school athletic budget, $15,000 youth soccer, $7,500 Bengals, $77,500 a year in total including cell tower revenue.
rows.amount: 77,500 a year (annual funding plan, as stated by speakers)
rows.requester: Parks Commission put forward both articles (Town Manager); DPW Director and Athletic Director presented
rows.quote: To recommend approval of Article 27 and 28 with the Board of Selectmen negotiating the lease
rows.note: Warrant prints "(Submitted by Board of Selectmen)"; the minute says the Parks Commission was putting both articles forward -- two descriptions of the same article; the document does not reconcile them.
rows.plain: The Select Board recommends the borrowing, 4-1; speakers describe $77,500 a year in contributions toward repaying it.

rows.what_happened: FY2017 Capital Plan list (12 requests, $780,975; items 1-10 funded, $619,475, cash, "There is no request to borrow funds") has no turf/track line. The turf and track went to a separate Article 28 borrowing.
rows.quote: The entire FY2017 Capital Budget of $619,475 will be funded through an outlay of cash. There is no request to borrow funds.
rows.note: Plan list at report p94. This shows the turf was handled outside the capital plan in FY2017; why is not stated there (hypothesis: debt route).
rows.plain: The FY2017 capital plan Town Meeting passes has no field line: the field goes by its own article instead.

rows.what_happened: Art. 28 voted: appropriate $770,000 to replace the artificial turf field and track, by borrowing (Ch. 44 s. 7(25)). The warrant printed $600,000.
rows.quote: VOTED 2/3RDS DECLARED to appropriate $770,000 to pay costs of replacing the artificial turf field and track at the school campus
rows.note: FY2016 annual report pdf p153. Warrant figure: "appropriate $600,000, or any other sum". Same page: Art. 27 cell tower lease also "VOTED 2/3RDS DECLARED". Confirms thread-history/TURF-HISTORY-COMPARISON D2.
rows.plain: Town Meeting votes to borrow $770,000 to replace the turf field and track. The warrant had printed $600,000.

rows.what_happened: Finance Committee recommended Article 28 (borrowing to renovate/replace turf field and track) 4-0; one member recused for a conflict of interest.
rows.quote: 28: Borrowing authorization to renovate/replace turf field and track.
rows.note: Minute is a garbled table; read Article 28 with "Recommend approval, finance committee 4-0" and "Karin recused". Quote is verbatim; recusal and 4-0 are from adjacent cells (reading, not quoted).
rows.plain: The Finance Committee recommends the borrowing, 4-0.

rows.quote: 770,000.00 Artificial Turf Field & Track
rows.note: pdf p43

rows.what_happened: Replacement under way: Parks Commission with Warner Larson Landscape Architects on specifications; bids planned by end of the month; field to be ready by end of October.
rows.quote: They are working with Warner Larson Landscape Architects to put together the technical specifications.
rows.plain: Replacement under way: specifications being written, bids by the end of August, field ready by the end of October.

rows.what_happened: Turf finished; track to be resurfaced in the spring; materials paid, track labour to be paid when done.
rows.quote: Pete advised the the turf is finished and that temporary lines are painted. Track will be resurfaced in the spring.
rows.note: Work done in FY2017 (turf) and FY2017-FY2018 (track).
rows.plain: Turf finished; the track is to be resurfaced in the spring.

rows.what_happened: Bond issuance approved: $2,580,000 in three items; artificial turf field $760,000 at 2.88%, twelve years (pavement management $1,675,000 at 2.92%, 15 years; rest sewer).
rows.vote: All in Favor (motion to approve the $2,580,000 bond as presented, all three items together)
rows.quote: Next is for the artificial turf field in the amount of $760,000 with an interest rate of 2.88% and the term is for twelve years.
rows.note: $10,000 below the $770,000 authorized. Bonds dated January 25, 2017 (SB 2017-04-04 minute).  Vote line: "To approve the bond in the amount of $2,580,000 as presented / Vote: All in Favor" (text lines 114-115).
rows.plain: The Select Board approves the bond sale: $760,000 for the turf field, over twelve years.

rows.what_happened: Premium article: $10,000 of turf field surplus applied to that project to reduce the borrowing; $6,350.40 remaining from the turf field to be placed in a special revenue fund for future capital.

rows.note: Pavement items are in the same sentence; read the turf clause only. Debt service about $75,000 a year for twelve years: SB 2017-10-23 minutes.
rows.plain: $10,000 of leftover turf money reduces the borrowing; $6,350.40 is set aside for future capital.
